```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(knitr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()

# Key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013).
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who                 , ~cfb_athlete_id ,
  "Arch Manning"       , "4870906"       ,
  "Nicco Marchiol"     , "4685459"       ,
  "Jordan Travis"      , "4360799"       ,
  "Cam Ward"           , "4688380"       ,
  "Trinidad Chambliss" , "4911529"       ,
  "Joe Burrow"         , "3915511"       ,
  "Malachi Nelson"     , "4870928"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# The same seven roster records as the timeline, through the last complete
# season; each covered game is one the game-statistics table holds for the team.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
ids <- subjects$cfb_athlete_id
ids_sql <- paste(sprintf("'%s'", ids), collapse = ",")
roster_rows <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  sprintf("SELECT * FROM roster WHERE playerId IN (%s)", ids_sql)
)
stat_seasons <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  sprintf(
    "SELECT DISTINCT playerId, season FROM player_stats WHERE playerId IN (%s)",
    ids_sql
  )
)
# Drop the roster seasons listed before a player's recruiting class (issue
# #114), as the pipeline's roster_enrolled does, before any flag is read.
recruiting_rows <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  sprintf(
    "SELECT playerId, recruit_name, hs_class FROM recruiting WHERE playerId IN (%s)",
    ids_sql
  )
)
roster_rows <- drop_pre_enrollment(
  roster_rows,
  recruiting_rows,
  stat_seasons,
  reused_ids(roster_rows)
)
flags <- flag_redshirt(roster_rows, stat_seasons) |>
  select(playerId, season, team) |>
  mutate(playerId = as.character(playerId))
pass_attempts <- tbl(con, "player_stats") |>
  filter(
    playerId %in% !!ids,
    category == "passing",
    statType == "ATT"
  ) |>
  transmute(playerId, season, attempts = as.numeric(stat)) |>
  collect()
player_games <- tbl(con, "game_player_stats") |>
  filter(playerId %in% !!ids, seasonType == "regular") |>
  distinct(playerId, season, gameId) |>
  count(playerId, season, name = "games_with_stat") |>
  collect()
covered <- tbl(con, "game_player_stats") |>
  filter(seasonType == "regular") |>
  distinct(season, team, gameId) |>
  count(season, team, name = "games_covered") |>
  collect()
team_colours <- tbl(con, "teams") |>
  select(team, color) |>
  collect()

spine <- redshirt_spine(flags, pass_attempts, player_games, covered) |>
  left_join(team_colours, by = "team") |>
  mutate(
    color = if_else(is.na(color), "#9CA3AF", color),
    who = subjects$who[match(playerId, subjects$cfb_athlete_id)],
    x = paste0("'", substr(season, 3, 4)),
    # "x of y" answers how many covered games showed a statistic.
    bar_label = if_else(
      is.na(games_covered),
      "no coverage",
      sprintf("%d of %d", games_with_stat, games_covered)
    ),
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s %d, %s: a statistic in %d of %s covered games; %s pass attempts",
      who,
      season,
      team,
      games_with_stat,
      coalesce(as.character(games_covered), "no"),
      coalesce(as.character(attempts), "no")
    )
  ) |>
  filter(season <= complete_through)

# One row per quarterback and one tile per season, as on the redshirt card:
# each tile reads "x/y", games with a statistic of the team's covered games.
spine <- spine |>
  mutate(
    tile_label = if_else(
      is.na(games_covered),
      "none",
      sprintf("%d/%d", games_with_stat, games_covered)
    ),
    who = factor(who, levels = rev(subjects$who))
  )
p <- ggplot(spine, aes(season, who)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(fill = color, tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(who, season)),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    height = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = tile_label), size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(spine$season), max(spine$season)),
    labels = \(x) paste0("'", substr(x, 3, 4))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Covered games with a statistic, by quarterback season",
    subtitle = "Each tile is a season in team colors: games with a recorded statistic out of the team's covered games",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Burrow's 2014 season is a pre-enrollment roster listing.\n",
      card_caption(release)
    )
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

card_thumbnail(p, "quarterback-game-coverage", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```
